# What Leads Them

*Ruan has put the tracks, the scratches and the ropes together before the First Warden. Iska wants to know what leads the climbers.*

## Objectives

1. Deliver 1 [Dougal's Measure](../items/dougals_measure.md)
2. Talk to [Iska](../npcs/first_warden_iska.md)
3. Defeat 3 Elite Disturbance-touched climbers ([Sea Newt](../monsters/sea_newt.md)) in [The Wrack Ledges](../maps/wrack_ledges.md)
4. Bring 3 [Climber's Sign](../items/climbers_sign.md) (taken)

## Rewards

- 24,500 EXP
- 1,850 mesos
- +40 standing with Goa Harbour
- +150 standing with [Ruan](../npcs/ruan_cliffwatch.md)
- Unlocks `boss.gapclaw`
